messages:
marta_sales: Heads up — EnterpriseBank asked if our on-prem package supports node-by-node rolling upgrades in fully air-gapped clusters and what the POC pricing for emergency hotfixes looks like. They want minimal downtime and clear signing proof.

leo_se: short: yes, rolling upgrades are supported but HA depends on replica counts and DB migration strategy. Operator issues per-pod updates; for stateful services recommend replicas >=2.

jin_eng: technical detail: we deliver signed minibundles (tar.gz) containing images + manifests + detached signature (notary v2 compatible). For airgap we expect customer to import to a local registry. Operator can then perform node drain/update/uncordon sequence for rolling restarts.

ops_sam: pricing: we can offer a POC hotfix add-on (48h triage + signed delta build + remote assist) at a fixed monthly fee for the POC term. Exact number to quoting. Note: delta bundles are smaller but require identical layer IDs across nodes.

marta_sales: they also asked about verifier commands to include in the security questionnaire. Can we provide a short snippet?

jin_eng: yes, add this to the questionnaire:

```
# verify checksum + detached signature
sha256sum bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
cosign verify-blob --signature bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz.sig bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
# import to local registry
ctr images import bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
```

leo_se: ops caveat: if their registry rewrites content-addressable ids we must run our preflight registry-check; it usually takes 10-30min. Otherwise delta bundles will mismatch and we fallback to full minibundle.

marta_sales: small SOW blurb for downtime expectations?

leo_se: SOW blurb: "Redwood's operator supports orchestrated, node-by-node rolling updates for air-gapped clusters when images are pre-imported to a local registry. High availability requires replica counts >=2 for stateful services; schema-changing DB migrations may require short maintenance windows. Redwood will provide monthly minibundles for the POC and can include a 48-hour emergency hotfix add-on for the POC term."

ops_sam: next steps: request from customer — jumpbox with registry access or artifact transfer method, whether they want Redwood-managed signing for POC or BYO-KMS, and confirmation of acceptable maintenance windows.

marta_sales: I'll send that + pricing note. tagging @security_qabot for final wording on the questionnaire. :+1:

security_qabot: Recommended answer for questionnaire field "bundle signing and key custody": "Bundles are produced with detached signatures (Notary v2). For POC Redwood can sign with ephemeral keys; for production customers may use BYO KMS/HSM. Verification commands and manifest checksums are provided; key rotation policy documented on request."
